title: SG-6.2 · Render LifecycleStepper in AdminApp with derived current stage
summary: AdminApp shows the lifecycle stepper with the current stage derived from the Round and execution status
description: Context: LifecycleStepper exists (game/frontend/src/components/LifecycleStepper.tsx) but AdminApp does not render it. Desired behavior: after the admin token is accepted, AdminApp shows the stepper with the current stage derived from the Round status and the current Round's execution status. Expected result: the admin sees where the Round is in OPEN → COMPLETED. Why: the admin needs a live lifecycle view.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated admin and an OPEN Round, when AdminApp loads, then the Round lifecycle stepper marks OPEN as the current step.
Given a CLOSED Round whose execution is RUNNING, when AdminApp loads, then DEVELOPING is the current step.
Given a unit test with mocked fetch, when it runs, then no real network is used.

preserve: Existing AdminApp token gate, round controls and contributions list

technical_constraints: Reuse existing STAGES, stageIndex and listExecutions/findExecutionForRound
definition_of_done: Stepper rendered in AdminApp and tests pass
